
A '''gismu''' consists either of an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants nitial-pair]], a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels tressed-vowel]], and a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]] composed of [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]] [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels owel]] (CCVCV), or of a [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]], a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels tressed-vowel]], a [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]], and a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]] composed of [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]] [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels owel]] (CVC/CV).
